plan_step: oof_green_review_20261020 review_and_plan.v2 GREEN-G1 second stage (matched baseline vs auxiliary A/B), scheduled 10/26-10/29 alongside replication
prior_stage: green_point_probe_20261023: frozen fold4 SSL5 tokens, linear 768->1 head, val5 mean F1 0.469 vs constant baseline 0
question: Does a train-only green point auxiliary loss during full regression fine-tuning change fold4 full-validation CD/CV/HEX MAPE, and does fine-tuning improve held-out green point localization over the frozen probe?
base_recipe: fold4 seed46 SSL5 mean pooling, regression20 schedule10, head lr 1e-3, encoder lr 1e-5, clip 1, effective batch 16, world size 2 — identical to phase2_pooling_20261020/arms/mean
runner: green_aux_regression_20261026.py wrapping the byte-identical frozen phase2_backbone_ssl_regression_20261020 runner

aux_design.head: Linear 768->1 on final normed patch tokens, float32, init identical to the frozen probe
aux_design.loss: BCE-with-logits against max-Gaussian sigma8 target on ROI support only (frozen probe formula)
aux_design.green_data: 20 fold4-train green images only; 5 fold4-validation green images never enter any loss
aux_design.sampling: one green image per rank per update appended to the second micro-batch; deterministic seed/epoch/step/rank schedule independent of global RNG
aux_design.geometry: 4 H/V flips with exactly transformed points and ROI; no photometric change
aux_design.objective: frozen regression loss + aux_weight * rank-mean point loss; clipping over all parameters

primary: terminal epoch20 full-validation (1790) mean MAPE, aux arm minus control_w0; no best-epoch switching, TTA, calibration or ensembles
secondary: val5 green point F1/recall/count error with the frozen probe peaks/NMS/matching, versus frozen probe 0.469 and constant baseline
encoder gradient norm ratio point/regression and cosine at init (smoke) and terminal
control_w0 minus historical fold4 seed46 mean arm (code-path sanity, not bitwise)
gate: Aux arm mean <= control -0.03pp is 'promising' only; promotion requires another seed and fold as in submission_plan promotion_gates. Flag CD/CV/HEX regression >0.05pp. GREEN-G2 teacher consistency stays blocked unless held-out point localization materially improves AND the user decides.
limitations: Single fold4 seed46 screen on a reused development fold
20 training / 5 validation green images; point metrics have high variance
Green ROI/points are not cell masks; original TIFF completeness unverified
Two pre-registered weights only; no tuning on validation
